date.as_written: sindhunāgamunināmayutābde mādhave himaruci(dyu)tiṣasṭhyāṃ sūryyaje ca divase ... sam 787 || vaiśā ṣaṣṭhi śanivāra kunhu

notes: The chronogram sindhu (7), nāga (8), muni (7) gives NS 787, confirmed by 'sam 787'. The phrase 'vīrabhadrariṣitāstu' appears to be corrupt for 'vīrabhadracaritāstu' or 'vīrabhadrāracitā astu', indicating Vīrabhadra as the commentator. The scribe is unnamed (only 'coyā').
